body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung introduced its new monitor ‘SyncMaster 2263DX’ and a multi-function printer ‘SCX-4500’ for office experience during the Samsung press conference at CES 2008.

The SyncMaster 2263DX monitor, a 22-inch LCD monitor featuring an additional 7-inch monitor connected to the display is ideal for users that require multiple screens to run programs and applications simultaneously. It is equipped with a built-in 2.0M pixel high-resolution webcam, dual-array microphone and speaker.

The SCX – 4500 features its quick copy speeds, blue LED status indicator lights for PC free operation, and high resolution color scanning capabilities. It is also designed to address common user concerns with button-less touch-sensor panels that reduce the user interface, a semi-automatic paper tray for easy paper replacement, guided toner path to ensure easy toner replacement plus easily recognizable warning lights.
